title: Analysis code for "Contrasting controls on tree methane emissions in upland and wetland forests"
description: R pipeline that turns the raw 1-Hz analyzer records and measurement times into the published stem CH4 flux dataset for Harvard Forest (2023-2025), and reproduces every figure, table, model and number in the paper and its Supporting Information. Data are read from the two Harvard Forest Data Archive datasets (stem flux; tomography) and public sources (AmeriFlux, NEON, PhenoCam); see README.md.
